globals.description: Tunables shared by all three boost lines.

flat_mode.description: false: boost accumulates every surviving income phase. true: permanent 10x flat boost applied once, removed on death.

range_shape.description: Which tiles a booster's buff/curse (and its RANGE overlay / selection highlight / pathfinding coverage) reach at the configured range_tiles: "plus" = cardinal arms only (range_tiles tiles out in each of N/S/E/W), "square" = a full Chebyshev square (every surrounding tile, like a defence building's range).

range_tiles.description: Magnitude of a booster's buff/curse range, shared by all three boost lines (Speed/Damage/HP) and every tier. Interpreted per range_shape.

starts_unlocked.description: Whether this building type is available to place/research from the start of a run (true), or must first be earned via a level-up unlock card (false).

tier_card_explanations.description: Body copy for the three boost lines' SHARED level-up research cards, one per tier in advance order (exactly 3). All three lines research a tier together from ONE card, so the card cannot use any single line's own tier explanation. Index 0 is unused (the tier-1 card is the unlock card, whose copy lives in game/buildings/research.py's ResearchSpec).

items.description: One merged boost research card's body copy.

tier_card_titles.description: Titles for the three boost lines' SHARED level-up research cards, one per tier in advance order (exactly 3). All three lines research a tier together from ONE card, so the card cannot use any single line's own tier name. Index 0 titles nothing directly - it is the previous-tier name the tier-2 card shows above its own title.

items.description: One merged boost research card's title.

Movement.description: Moving an already-placed building to another unbuilt buildable tile. Cost and duration both scale with the Chebyshev tile distance from the origin: value = base + (distance // increment) * increase, or 0 when the matching *_enabled flag is off.

base_love_cost.description: Love charged for a move of distance 0..(love_cost_increase_increment-1) tiles, before any distance steps are added.

base_moving_time.description: Rounds a move of distance 0..(moving_time_increase_increment-1) tiles takes, before any distance steps are added. 0 with time_cost_enabled on means every move is instant.

love_cost_increase.description: Extra love added per completed distance step (one step per love_cost_increase_increment tiles of Chebyshev distance).

love_cost_increase_increment.description: Tiles of Chebyshev distance per love-cost step. Minimum 1 - the formula floor-divides by this value.

money_cost_enabled.description: If false, moving a building is free (cost is always 0) and the base/increase love keys are ignored.

moving_time_increase.description: Extra rounds added per completed distance step (one step per moving_time_increase_increment tiles of Chebyshev distance).

moving_time_increase_increment.description: Tiles of Chebyshev distance per moving-time step. Minimum 1 - the formula floor-divides by this value.

time_cost_enabled.description: If false, moving a building is instant (0 rounds - the building relocates the moment the move is confirmed) and the base/increase time keys are ignored.

defence_range_pathfinding.description: Defence coverage feeding enemy path weights (conceptually map, kept here per REPLAN).

enabled.description: If true, tiles inside any defender's range add path_weight_add to enemy pathfinding cost.

path_weight_add.description: Path weight added to each tile covered by a defender's range.

placement_reveal_delay_seconds.description: Seconds a freshly-placed building's sprite stays hidden before it appears (a cosmetic reveal delay so the placement VFX/feedback plays first) - purely visual, never delays occupancy, stats or combat, which are all live the instant place_building returns. 0 disables the delay (the building appears instantly, pre-feature behaviour).

items.description: One data/slots.json asset-slot key: the card art for this tier.

starts_unlocked.description: Whether this building type is available to place/research from the start of a run (true), or must first be earned via a level-up unlock card (false).

tiers.description: Wall builder tiers in advance order.

title: buildings
